svg.text: How we approach each segment and decision maker
Each segment has a natural entry persona, a lead module and a first offer. We choose one of four plays per account,
and we offer a clear pricing framework — models, not invented numbers — until delivery costs and pilot findings set the

g.text: doors to B, C and D.

svg.text: Enter where the pain is sharpest with one module and a paid pilot, then expand to the full front door. Publish
prices only after delivery costs and pilot value are known; until then, sell the framework and the pilot.
Capability status shown on the poster where relevant
Readiness: capabilities marked LIVE are built and tested; none is yet proven in a customer production environment. No customer results, ROI, certifications or prices are claimed.
